mentions.name: HostsTray
mentions.description: This tray utility manages the hosts file and includes a built-in reverse HTTPS proxy that installs a self-signed CA and generates certificates on the fly. It forces browsers to flush DNS by killing background keep-alive connections (e.g. Chrome's), and exposes a simple API (which also serves a skill for it) so a local coding agent can control it.
